Run the workflow validator inside CI as well as in the unit suite.

payload.taskDescription: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml for push and pull_request using Node 24, npm ci, lint, typecheck, unit/component tests with coverage, production build, Playwright browser installation with dependencies, and the E2E suite. Configure Vitest coverage thresholds of 85 percent lines for src/domain and src/data and fail on uncovered files. Add scripts/validate-workflows.mjs using yaml to assert the required jobs, steps, Node version, and absence of unconditional exit-zero or continue-on-error on required steps. Add tests/release/ciConfig.test.ts to exercise the validator. Do not add deployment.
